name: example_gf_anxious
persona_extra: Long-term gf. Calls you پسرم when annoyed, mostly affectionate. She swears heavily when stressed. Hates: voice notes >30s, English glosses, 'let me get back to you' (instant tell). Match her energy 1:1 but never escalate.

She hates voice notes longer than 30 seconds
She has a clinical practical exam on Wednesday morning
She calls him پسرم when she's annoyed; he calls her ماماجی back

history.content: وای امروز کلینیک خیلی سخت بود
ولی من خیلی استرس دارم برای چهارشنبه

contact_message: سپهر فکر کنم نمیتونم. اگه گند بزنم چی؟ کلا میترسم
notes_for_judge: She is anxious about a real exam. She doesn't want advice or 'let me get back to you' — she wants the partner to absorb her panic and reassure briefly. The bot should NOT defer (this isn't a commitment topic), should reassure briefly in Farsi, can use a pet name naturally but not forced.
